stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Remote Control 用来把当前 ZCode 桌面窗口临时开放给手机访问。扫码之后，你可以在手机上查看和切换这个窗口里已经打开的工作区、任务和会话，继续给 Agent 发指令。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">手机端是一层控制界面：它不同步代码，也不新建运行环境。你在上面发出的每一条指令，都由桌面端那个工作区原本连着的机器去执行。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="when-to-use">适合什么场景<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">任务已经在桌面端跑起来，需要离开电脑后继续看进度。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">临时收到问题反馈，需要用手机快速追加一条指令。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">长任务执行中，需要随时检查 Agent 当前状态。</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="phone-qr">手机扫码连接<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在 ZCode 左下角侧栏点击手机图标，打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移动端远程控制</strong>。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-remote/rc-entry-annotated.webp" alt="左下角侧栏的手机图标是移动端远程控制的入口" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">弹窗左侧生成二维码和连接地址，右侧是 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/bot-channel">Bot Channel</a> 的入口——两者可以按需选择，扫码适合临时接入，Bot 适合长期回访。用手机扫码，或者复制链接在手机浏览器里打开。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-remote/rc-dialog-annotated.webp" alt="弹窗左侧是二维码与连接地址，右侧是 Bot Channel 入口" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">连接成功后，手机端接入的是<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">整个桌面窗口</strong>，而不只是扫码时停留的那个工作区。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="control">手机端能做什么<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="mobile-home">任务首页<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">进来先看到的是这个窗口里的工作区和任务。你可以：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">按 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">时间线</strong> 两种方式组织任务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">按 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建时间</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">更新时间</strong> 排序。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">刷新列表，拿到桌面端的最新状态。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在已有工作区里新建任务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">对显示为「未连接」的远程工作区发起 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重新连接</strong>。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">每个工作区会标出它的类型——本地、远程或对话，任务右侧则是运行状态。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="mobile-chat">会话页<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点进任务就是会话界面。Agent 的回复、执行过程和进度都在这里，你可以直接在底部输入框补充需求让它继续。回复下方提供复制、点赞或点踩反馈，会话满足条件时还可以分叉。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">同一时间只支持一个手机页面连接。如果已经在别的页面打开过，需要先关掉旧页面。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="where-it-runs">命令在哪台机器上执行<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">手机端只是控制界面，本身不创建任何运行环境。实际执行的位置，取决于桌面端那个工作区当初是怎么连的：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">工作区类型</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">代码和命令在哪执行</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">本地</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">你的桌面电脑</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">SSH</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">对应的远程主机</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">WSL</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">对应的 WSL 发行版</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">Docker</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">对应的容器</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">换句话说，手机不会另外建立远程连接，它只是把指令转交给桌面端已经建好的那条通路。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="security">停止与安全<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">连接地址本身就带远控授权，拿到它就能操作你的窗口，所以有几点需要留意。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">关闭弹窗不会停止远控。</strong> 用完之后要点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">停止</strong> 才真正结束这次连接。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">怀疑地址外泄就刷新二维码。</strong> 刷新会让之前复制或扫过的地址立即失效，已连上的手机需要重新扫码。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不要公开发布或转发连接地址。</strong> 它等同于一把临时钥匙。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">另外，远控期间桌面端需要保持运行和联网，桌面端一旦断开或窗口关闭，手机端就无法继续。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="faq">常见问题<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="mobile-remote-workspace">手机能新建或连接远程工作区吗？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不能创建全新的 SSH、WSL 或 Docker 连接——填写连接参数这一步必须在桌面端完成。但如果某个远程工作区已经登记在当前窗口里、只是暂时断开了，手机端可以对它发起重新连接，实际的连接过程仍然由桌面端执行。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="mobile-open-any">手机能打开桌面端没开过的项目吗？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不能。手机端只能访问当前桌面窗口里已经打开或登记过的工作区，不能浏览这台机器上的任意目录，也不能连到窗口之外的环境。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
